<b>Straight Pin</b> is a {{CrestSlot|Red|1}} in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. When used, [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] quickly tosses a pin directly forwards. It can be blocked by attacks and armour.

== Usefulness ==
Straight Pins can be thrown quickly, have a high maximum capacity, and cost very few [[Shell Shards]] per use, making them easy to continuously fire without consequence.

The pins can be a useful long range attack in the early game.

{{clear|left}}

== How to Acquire ==
Found inside of [[Grindle]]'s cell in [[the Marrow]].
